Culture Media Analysis

Michael Whitehouse

2026-03-04

Embryo Culture Outcomes

  • fresh autologous IVF and EMBRYO BANKING attempts in the KindEMR
  • GM-CSF media used for cycles where the “Golds Media” procedure was documented
  • Global media used at Lindbergh prior to 2024-08-02, at West Loop prior to 2025-01-01
  • Irvine media used otherwise
  • compare Global vs. Irvine media outcomes at Lindbergh and West Loop labs, excluding other media and labs
  • compare fertilization rates, usable blastocyst rates (Gardner grade 3BB or better by Day 6, or 4BB by Day 7), and euploidy rates
  • adjust for oocyte age and other relevant covariates
  • GEE logistict regression clustering at patient level to account for multiple cycles per patient and within-patient correlation
  • adjust for non-linear effects of age both by SART age group and splines for comparison

Transfer Outcomes

  • autologous euploid single embryo transfers (SETs) of embryos cultured in each respective culture media
  • exclude transfers too recent to have outcome data, as with KPI queries
    • include_in_bhcg_outcomes = TRUE for chemical pregnancy rate
    • include_in_sac_fh_outcomes = TRUE for clinical pregnancy rate

Load Processed Data

# Define paths (project_dir already set in load-libraries chunk)
scripts_dir <- fs::path(project_dir, "scripts")

refresh_query <- FALSE
write_data_files <- FALSE
source(fs::path(scripts_dir, "process_raw_data.R"))

kpis_ivf <- kpis |>
  filter(include_kpi_ivf_cycles) |>
  filter(d1_culture_media %in% c("Global", "Irvine"), lab_location %in% c("Lindbergh", "West Loop")) |>
  drop_na(d1_culture_media)

kpis_fet <- kpis |>
  filter(include_kpi_single_autologous_euploid_fet) |>
  drop_na(transferred_embryos_d1_culture_media) |>
  filter(lab_location %in% c("Lindbergh", "West Loop")) |>
  mutate(
    day_number = as.factor(transferred_embryos_developmental_day_min),
    # extract elements of gardner grades e.g. "4AA" -> expansion = 4, icm_grade = A, troph_grade = A
    expansion = str_extract(transferred_blastocyst_grade_at_cryo, "\\d+"),
    icm_grade = str_extract(transferred_blastocyst_grade_at_cryo, "[A-C](?=$|[A-C])"),
    troph_grade = str_extract(transferred_blastocyst_grade_at_cryo, "[A-C]$")
  ) |>
  filter(expansion >= 3) # restrict to transfers of blastocysts with at least expansion 3, as these are the ones considered "usable" in the culture outcomes analyses

Culture Outcomes

t1_data <- kpis_ivf |>
  select(
    d1_culture_media, age, bmi, protocol,
      starts_with("attempt_diagnosis"),
    eggs_retrieved, d0_hyaled, d0_icsi, d1_icsi_2pn,
    d1_2pn_ongoing_to_d5, total_blasts,
    usable_blasts,
    embryos_biopsied, pgta_euploid
  ) |>
  mutate_at(vars(eggs_retrieved, d0_hyaled, d0_icsi, d1_icsi_2pn, d1_2pn_ongoing_to_d5, total_blasts, usable_blasts, embryos_biopsied, pgta_euploid), as.integer) |>
  auto_label()

t1_main <- t1_data |>
  tbl_summary(by = d1_culture_media) |>
  add_p(test = list(
    all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test",
    all_continuous() ~ "wilcox.test"
  )) |>
  add_overall() |>
  modify_spanning_header(c(stat_1, stat_2) ~ "**Culture Media**") |>
  bold_labels()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTION TO CALCULATE COUNTS, RATES, CIs, & P-VALUES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_rate_row <- function(df, metric_name, num_var, den_var) {
  # Helper to format string as: n/N (Rate%) [95% CI]
  get_ci_string <- function(x, n) {
    if (is.na(n) || n == 0) {
      return("NA")
    }
    test <- prop.test(x, n)
    est <- test$estimate * 100
    ci_lower <- test$conf.int[1] * 100
    ci_upper <- test$conf.int[2] * 100

    # %d formats the integer count, %.1f formats the decimal
    sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%) [%.1f%%, %.1f%%]", x, n, est, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  }

  # 1. Overall Stats
  tot_num <- sum(df[[num_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  tot_den <- sum(df[[den_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  stat_0 <- get_ci_string(tot_num, tot_den)

  # 2. Grouped Stats (Alphabetical: stat_1 = Global, stat_2 = Irvine)
  df_grp <- df |>
    group_by(d1_culture_media) |>
    summarize(
      x = sum(.data[[num_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(.data[[den_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(d1_culture_media) # Ensure Global is first, Irvine is second

  stat_1 <- get_ci_string(df_grp$x[1], df_grp$n[1])
  stat_2 <- get_ci_string(df_grp$x[2], df_grp$n[2])

  # 3. P-value (2-proportion Z-test comparing Global vs Irvine)
  pval <- NA_real_
  if (all(df_grp$n > 0)) {
    ptest <- prop.test(df_grp$x, df_grp$n)
    pval <- ptest$p.value
  }

  # Return formatted row for gtsummary
  tibble(
    label = metric_name,
    stat_0 = stat_0,
    stat_1 = stat_1,
    stat_2 = stat_2,
    p.value = pval,
    row_type = "label",
    var_type = "continuous",
    variable = metric_name
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. GENERATE THE NEW ROWS FOR POOLED RATES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
rate_rows <- bind_rows(
  calc_rate_row(t1_data, "Maturity Rate (Pooled)", "d0_icsi", "d0_hyaled"),
  calc_rate_row(t1_data, "Fertilization Rate (Pooled)", "d1_icsi_2pn", "d0_icsi"),
  calc_rate_row(t1_data, "Blastulation Rate (Pooled)", "d1_2pn_ongoing_to_d5", "d1_icsi_2pn"),
  calc_rate_row(t1_data, "Usable Blast Rate (Pooled)", "usable_blasts", "d1_icsi_2pn"),
  calc_rate_row(t1_data, "Euploidy Rate (Pooled)", "pgta_euploid", "embryos_biopsied")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. INJECT ROWS INTO GTSUMMARY TABLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------
final_table <- t1_main |>
  modify_table_body(~ bind_rows(.x, rate_rows)) |>
  # Update footnotes to clearly explain the new rich formatting
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "Patient-level counts: Median [IQR]; Pooled rates: n/N (%) [95% CI]"
  ) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Cycle Characteristics and Pooled Clinical Outcomes by Culture Media**")

Usable Blast Rate by Age and Culture Media

usable_rate_plot_data <- kpis_ivf |>
  transmute(
    d1_culture_media,
    age = as.numeric(age),
    n_2pn = as.integer(d1_icsi_2pn_ongoing_to_d5),
    usable_blasts = as.integer(usable_blasts_d1_icsi_2pn)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(n_2pn), n_2pn > 0, !is.na(usable_blasts)) |>
  mutate(
    usable_blasts = pmax(0L, pmin(usable_blasts, n_2pn)),
    age_year = floor(age)
  ) |>
  group_by(d1_culture_media, age_year) |>
  summarize(
    n_2pn = sum(n_2pn, na.rm = TRUE),
    usable_blasts = sum(usable_blasts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    usable_blast_rate = usable_blasts / n_2pn
  )

plot1 <- ggplot(usable_rate_plot_data, aes(x = age_year, y = usable_blast_rate, color = d1_culture_media, group = d1_culture_media)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_2pn), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Pooled 2PNs (N)") +
  labs(
    title = "Usable Blast Rate by Age and Culture Media",
    subtitle = "Total usable blasts divided by total 2PNs",
    x = "Age (binned by year)",
    y = "Usable blast rate",
    color = "Culture media"
  )

add_kb_logo(plot1)

Figure 1. Usable blast rate by age and culture media (pooled usable blasts / pooled 2PNs).

Euploid Rate by Age and Culture Media

euploid_rate_plot_data <- kpis_ivf |>
  filter(d1_culture_media %in% c("Global", "Irvine")) |>
  transmute(
    d1_culture_media,
    age = as.numeric(age),
    embryos_biopsied = as.integer(embryos_biopsied),
    pgta_euploid = as.integer(pgta_euploid)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(embryos_biopsied), embryos_biopsied > 0, !is.na(pgta_euploid)) |>
  mutate(
    pgta_euploid = pmax(0L, pmin(pgta_euploid, embryos_biopsied)),
    age_year = floor(age)
  ) |>
  group_by(d1_culture_media, age_year) |>
  summarize(
    embryos_biopsied = sum(embryos_biopsied, na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_euploid = sum(pgta_euploid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    euploid_rate = pgta_euploid / embryos_biopsied
  )

plot2 <- ggplot(euploid_rate_plot_data, aes(x = age_year, y = euploid_rate, color = d1_culture_media, group = d1_culture_media)) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Pooled Biopsied Embryos (N)") +

    color = "Culture media"
  )

add_kb_logo(plot2)

GEE Logistic Regression Models for Culture Outcomes

# Prepare data in long format: one row per embryo
blast_data <- kpis_ivf |>
  select(patient_id, d1_culture_media, bmi, age, age_group, d1_icsi_2pn, d1_2pn_ongoing_to_d5) |>
  mutate(
    n_embryos = as.integer(d1_icsi_2pn),
    n_blasts = as.integer(d1_2pn_ongoing_to_d5),
    n_blasts = pmax(0L, pmin(n_blasts, n_embryos))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) |>
  filter(!is.na(d1_culture_media)) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_embryos) & n_embryos > 0) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_blasts)) |>
  mutate(cycle_row_id = row_number()) |>
  tidyr::uncount(weights = n_embryos) |>
  group_by(cycle_row_id) |>
  mutate(
    blast_outcome = as.integer(row_number() <= first(n_blasts))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    d1_culture_media = factor(d1_culture_media),
    age_group = factor(age_group)
  )

# Keep only complete model rows
blast_model_data <- blast_data |>
  filter(!is.na(bmi), !is.na(age_group)) |>
  mutate(culture_media = d1_culture_media) |>
  droplevels() |>
  auto_label()

# Guardrails: stop early with useful diagnostics
if (nrow(blast_model_data) == 0) {
  stop("No rows available for model after filtering for non-missing BMI/oocyte_age_group.")
}
if (dplyr::n_distinct(blast_model_data$d1_culture_media) < 2) {
  stop("d1_culture_media has <2 levels in model data.")
}
if (dplyr::n_distinct(blast_model_data$age_group) < 2) {
  stop("oocyte_age_group has <2 levels in model data.")
}

# Fit GEE logistic regression
model <- geepack::geeglm(
  blast_outcome ~ culture_media + age_group,
  id = patient_id,
  data = blast_model_data,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

# Show model summary
tbl2 <- tbl_regression(model, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 2. Adjusted Odds of Usable Blastocyst Formation by Culture Media (GEE Model)**") |>
  modify_footnote(
    estimate ~ "Outcome modeled is usable blastocyst formation (Gardner grade 3BB or better by Day 7). Population-averaged odds ratios from a logistic GEE model with exchangeable working correlation; embryos clustered within patient (id = patient_id) and robust (sandwich) standard errors used for within-patient correlation."
  )

print(tbl2)

plot_forest(model, title = "Forest Plot: Usable Blastocyst Formation (Age Group Model)", caption = "Reference categories are model baseline levels.")

Figure 5. Forest plot of adjusted odds for usable blastocyst formation by culture media (age-group GEE model). 

# Build explicit spline basis terms so they are displayed cleanly in tbl_regression
blast_model_data_spline <- blast_model_data |>
  mutate(
    age_spline = splines::ns(age, df = 4),
    age_spline_1 = age_spline[, 1],
    age_spline_2 = age_spline[, 2],
    age_spline_3 = age_spline[, 3],
    age_spline_4 = age_spline[, 4]
  ) |>
  select(-age_spline)

# Fit GEE logistic regression with continuous age, using splines to fit expected s-shaped curve
model_continuous_age <- geepack::geeglm(
  blast_outcome ~ culture_media + age_spline_1 + age_spline_2 + age_spline_3 + age_spline_4,
  id = patient_id,
  data = blast_model_data_spline,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

spline_term_labels <- list(
  age_spline_1 ~ "Age (non-linear term 1)",
  age_spline_2 ~ "Age (non-linear term 2)",
  age_spline_3 ~ "Age (non-linear term 3)",
  age_spline_4 ~ "Age (non-linear term 4)"
)

tbl3 <- tbl_regression(
  model_continuous_age,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  include = c(culture_media, age_spline_1, age_spline_2, age_spline_3, age_spline_4),
  label = spline_term_labels
) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 3. Adjusted Odds of Usable Blastocysts by Culture Media (GEE Model; age treated as continuous using natural spline terms)**") |>
  modify_footnote(
    estimate ~ "Outcome modeled is usable blastocyst formation (Gardner grade 3BB or better by Day 7). Population-averaged odds ratios from a logistic GEE model with exchangeable working correlation; embryos clustered within patient (id = patient_id) and robust (sandwich) standard errors used for within-patient correlation."
  )

print(tbl3)

Euploid Rate

# Prepare data in long format: one row per biopsied embryo
euploid_data <- kpis_ivf |>
  select(patient_id, d1_culture_media, bmi, age, age_group, embryos_biopsied, pgta_euploid) |>
  mutate(
    n_biopsied = as.integer(embryos_biopsied),
    n_euploid = as.integer(pgta_euploid),
    n_euploid = pmax(0L, pmin(n_euploid, n_biopsied))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) |>
  filter(!is.na(d1_culture_media)) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_biopsied) & n_biopsied > 0) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_euploid)) |>
  mutate(cycle_row_id = row_number()) |>
  tidyr::uncount(weights = n_biopsied) |>
  group_by(cycle_row_id) |>
  mutate(
    euploid_outcome = as.integer(row_number() <= first(n_euploid))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    d1_culture_media = factor(d1_culture_media),
    age_group = factor(age_group)
  )

# Keep only complete model rows
euploid_model_data <- euploid_data |>
  filter(!is.na(bmi), !is.na(age_group)) |>
  mutate(culture_media = d1_culture_media) |>
  droplevels() |>
  auto_label()

# Guardrails: stop early with useful diagnostics
if (nrow(euploid_model_data) == 0) {
  stop("No rows available for model after filtering for non-missing BMI/oocyte_age_group.")
}
if (dplyr::n_distinct(euploid_model_data$d1_culture_media) < 2) {
  stop("d1_culture_media has <2 levels in model data.")
}
if (dplyr::n_distinct(euploid_model_data$age_group) < 2) {
  stop("oocyte_age_group has <2 levels in model data.")
}

# Fit GEE logistic regression
euploid_model <- geepack::geeglm(
  euploid_outcome ~ culture_media + age_group,
  id = patient_id,
  data = euploid_model_data,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

# Show model summary
tbl4 <- tbl_regression(euploid_model, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 4. Adjusted Odds of Euploidy by Culture Media (GEE Model)**") |>
  modify_footnote(
    estimate ~ "Population-averaged odds ratios from a logistic GEE model with exchangeable working correlation; biopsied embryos clustered within patient (id = patient_id) and robust (sandwich) standard errors used for within-patient correlation."
  )

# Build explicit spline basis terms so they are displayed cleanly in tbl_regression
euploid_model_data_spline <- euploid_model_data |>
  mutate(
    age_spline = splines::ns(age, df = 4),
    age_spline_1 = age_spline[, 1],
    age_spline_2 = age_spline[, 2],
    age_spline_3 = age_spline[, 3],
    age_spline_4 = age_spline[, 4]
  ) |>
  select(-age_spline) |>
  auto_label()

# Fit GEE logistic regression with continuous age, using splines to fit expected non-linear curve
euploid_model_continuous_age <- geepack::geeglm(
  euploid_outcome ~ culture_media + age_spline_1 + age_spline_2 + age_spline_3 + age_spline_4,
  id = patient_id,
  data = euploid_model_data_spline,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

tbl5 <- tbl_regression(
  euploid_model_continuous_age,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  include = c(culture_media, age_spline_1, age_spline_2, age_spline_3, age_spline_4),
  label = spline_term_labels
) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 5. Adjusted Odds of Euploidy by Culture Media (GEE Model; age treated as continuous using natural spline terms)**") |>
  modify_footnote(
    estimate ~ "Population-averaged odds ratios from a logistic GEE model with exchangeable working correlation; biopsied embryos clustered within patient (id = patient_id) and robust (sandwich) standard errors used for within-patient correlation."
  )

Transfer Outcome Rate Plots by Age and Culture Media

to_binary01 <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(as.integer(x))
  }
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(dplyr::case_when(
      x == 1 ~ 1L,
      x == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  x_chr <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("1", "true", "t", "yes", "y", "positive", "pos", "pregnant") ~ 1L,
    x_chr %in% c("0", "false", "f", "no", "n", "negative", "neg", "not pregnant") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}

transfer_model_data <- kpis_fet |>
  transmute(
    patient_id,
    culture_media = factor(transferred_embryos_d1_culture_media),
    age_group = factor(age_group),
    age,
    day_number, expansion,
    icm_grade, troph_grade,
    prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers,
    positive_pregnancy_beta_hcg = to_binary01(preg_attempt_outcome),
    positive_pregnancy_gestational_sac = to_binary01(preg_sac)
  )
beta_plot_data <- transfer_model_data |>
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(positive_pregnancy_beta_hcg)) |>
  mutate(age_year = floor(age)) |>
  group_by(culture_media, age_year) |>
  summarize(
    n_transfers = n(),
    positive_rate = mean(positive_pregnancy_beta_hcg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot3 <- ggplot(beta_plot_data, aes(x = age_year, y = positive_rate, color = culture_media, group = culture_media)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_transfers), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Transfers with beta-hCG outcome (N)") +
  labs(
    title = "Positive Beta-hCG Rate by Age and Culture Media",
    subtitle = "Observed positive beta-hCG outcomes among single euploid transfers",
    x = "Age (binned by year)",
    y = "Positive beta-hCG rate",
    color = "Culture media"
  )

add_kb_logo(plot3)

Figure 3. Positive beta-hCG rate by age and culture media (single euploid transfer attempts with observed beta-hCG outcomes).

  summarize(

beta_model_data <- transfer_model_data |>
  select(day_number, expansion, icm_grade, troph_grade, prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers,
    patient_id, age, age_group, culture_media, positive_pregnancy_beta_hcg) |>
  drop_na() |>
  droplevels() |>
  auto_label()

  stop("No rows available for positive beta-hCG model after filtering.")

  stop("culture_media has <2 levels in positive beta-hCG model data.")
}

  stop("age_group has <2 levels in positive beta-hCG model data.")
}
